_how_to_use: One entry per claim from data/filing_notes/ that is marked unverified. scripts/verify_claims.py checks each one against a primary source. 'check' picks the method: sec_form4_purchases, sec_filing_text, fda_drugsfda, web_page_contains, ctgov_results, manual. Remove an entry once you no longer need it checked.

params.where: Department of Health Abu Dhabi news (https://www.doh.gov.ae/en/news; items load by JavaScript, so open it in a browser) and the DOH IRB Research Registry (https://www.doh.gov.ae/en/programs-initiatives/Test_code). On 2026-10-16 the registry page listed no study mentioning NeOnc, NEO100, NEO212 or glioma; the registry covers studies reviewed by the DOH ethics committee, not IND authorizations
params.why_manual: No public API or searchable register found for DoH Abu Dhabi IND authorizations.

params.where: Next NTHI 8-K or 10-Q after 2026-11-17 in EDGAR (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=1979414&type=8-K&dateb=&owner=include&count=40); fetch_sec_8k.py will pick it up
